checklist.evidence: A date counts as invalid if it's empty, `0000:00:00 00:00:00`, before 1990 or in the future.
Sort same-second files by subsecond time, then by original name, so the result is the same every run.
The tool runs as a dry run unless you pass `--apply`.
First rename everything to temporary names (`.exifrename-tmp-<uuid>`), then to the final names.
`--undo LOGFILE` reverses the renames in reverse order and checks that each file still exists under its new name first.
`--tz-offset ±HH:MM` Shift times ... note this value is stored in UTC
files with the same base name (`IMG_1234.HEIC` + `IMG_1234.MOV` + `IMG_1234.xmp`/`.AAE`) are renamed together and share one base name.
default "{date:%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S}" ... clean up anything a template produces (`:`, `/`, `\`, `?`
